data.title: UAE seeks diplomatic breakthrough with Iran amid Gulf unrest | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: At a Bahrain security summit, UAE adviser Anwar Gargash called for diplomacy with Iran while warning that Gulf states remain prepared for more conflict.
